  WHY: Deriving the hour from the epoch with `date -u -d "@${stall_now_epoch}" +%H` makes both values come from one clock read (1 line changed, HARDENING_RISK_SCORE 1). Only openai_gpt-6-luna stated a severity (NIT); the other three gave none.

  WHY: The docs mislead an operator debugging `outcome=already_alerted` whose PR comment carries yesterday's date. There is no runtime failure (NIT).

Fix: derive the hour from `stall_now_epoch` (1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
